keyParagraphs: Sudah beli aircond sendiri dan hanya perlukan juruteknik untuk pemasangan? Panduan ini menerangkan harga upah pasang aircond Selangor, apa yang termasuk dalam pakej asas, caj tambahan selepas 5 kaki, proses kerja dan cara mendapatkan quotation dengan lebih cepat.

Pemasangan aircond bukan sekadar menebuk dinding dan menyambung paip. Kedudukan indoor unit, laluan copper pipe, wiring, drainage, vacuum dan pemeriksaan selepas pemasangan semuanya mempengaruhi hasil kerja.

RK Reno Solution menyediakan servis pemasangan untuk rumah, apartment, pejabat, kedai dan ruang komersial kecil di Selangor serta sekitar Lembah Klang. Untuk servis terus, lihat juga halaman Aircond Installation Selangor.

faqs.question: Berapa harga pemasangan aircond 1.0HP dan 1.5HP?
faqs.answer: Harga pemasangan asas ialah RM220. Harga ini termasuk 5 kaki copper pipe dan 5 kaki wiring.

faqs.question: Berapa harga pemasangan aircond 2.0HP dan 2.5HP?
faqs.answer: Harga pemasangan asas ialah RM280. Harga ini termasuk 5 kaki copper pipe dan 5 kaki wiring.

faqs.question: Bagaimana jika copper pipe atau wiring melebihi 5 kaki?
faqs.answer: Setiap kaki tambahan akan dicaj berdasarkan ukuran sebenar, HP aircond, spesifikasi bahan dan keadaan tapak.

faqs.question: Adakah cabut unit lama termasuk dalam harga asas?
faqs.answer: Tidak. Dismantle unit lama ialah kerja tambahan dan akan dicaj berdasarkan HP, lokasi serta kesukaran akses.

faqs.question: Boleh pasang aircond yang saya beli sendiri?
faqs.answer: Boleh. Hantar jenama, model, HP dan gambar lokasi supaya team boleh menyemak skop pemasangan.

faqs.question: Perlu site visit sebelum dapat harga?
faqs.answer: Anggaran awal boleh diberikan melalui WhatsApp apabila pelanggan menghantar lokasi, HP dan gambar tapak. Harga akhir bergantung pada keadaan sebenar.

faqs.question: Apa maksud pemasangan back-to-back?
faqs.answer: Back-to-back biasanya bermaksud indoor unit dan outdoor unit dipasang berdekatan pada dinding yang sama, jadi laluan paip lebih pendek.

faqs.question: Adakah servis tersedia untuk pejabat dan kedai?

routes.h1: House Renovation in Kuala Lumpur: The Ultimate Planning & Cost Guide (2026)
importantHeadings: How Much Does House Renovation Cost in Kuala Lumpur?
keyParagraphs: House renovation costs in Kuala Lumpur can start with a few hundred ringgit for one small room and rise substantially for kitchens, bathrooms, full-condo work or structural changes. The safest way to plan is to define the exact scope, separate essential work from optional finishes and request an itemised quotation.

This guide provides low-entry starting estimates for painting, tiling, bathroom work, kitchen renovation and basic home refreshes. The figures are intended for early budget planning. They are not fixed packages because property condition, materials, access, hacking, disposal and building rules can change the final cost.
For contractor services rather than general cost information, visit the House Renovation in Kuala Lumpur service page or the House Renovation in Selangor page.

faqs.question: What is the minimum cost to start a small renovation?
faqs.answer: A small, clearly limited job may begin from around RM400, such as a basic room repaint. The minimum charge still depends on location, preparation, materials and the amount of labour required.

faqs.question: How much is a basic condo refresh in Kuala Lumpur?
faqs.answer: A limited cosmetic refresh may start around RM8,000. This is not a complete-unit renovation and may only cover selected painting, minor repairs or simple improvements.

faqs.question: How much does bathroom renovation cost?
faqs.answer: A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000, while a basic fuller renovation may start around RM6,000. Hacking, waterproofing, plumbing, tiles and sanitary fittings affect the final cost.

faqs.question: How much does kitchen renovation cost?
faqs.answer: A selected kitchen refresh may start around RM8,000, while a broader basic kitchen renovation may start around RM15,000. Cabinet length, material, countertop, plumbing, hacking and appliances affect the total.

faqs.question: Why are renovation quotations so different?
faqs.answer: Quotations may include different materials, quantities, preparation, disposal and finishing work. Compare the detailed scope rather than comparing only the final total.

faqs.question: Should I keep money for unexpected work?
faqs.answer: Yes. Hidden leaks, old wiring, damaged floors and plumbing problems may only become visible after hacking or removal. Keep part of the budget available for approved variations.

faqs.question: Do condo renovations require management approval?
faqs.answer: Many condos require renovation forms, contractor registration, deposits, lift protection and compliance with approved working hours. Check the building's rules before work starts.

faqs.question: Do landed-house extensions require approval?
faqs.answer: Extensions, roof changes, additional floors and structural alterations may require drawings or approval. Confirm the exact requirement with the relevant authority or a qualified professional.

faqs.question: Can I get a renovation estimate through WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: An initial estimate may be possible when you send clear photos, videos, measurements, location and the required work. A site review may still be needed before confirming the final quotation.

Apa Yang Termasuk Dalam Pakej Cuci Rumah?
keyParagraphs: Sedang cari pakej cuci rumah untuk kondo, rumah teres, rumah selepas renovasi, atau persediaan sebelum Hari Raya? RK Reno Solution menyediakan servis cuci rumah di Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Setapak, Cheras, Wangsa Maju, dan kawasan sekitar.
Pakej ini sesuai jika anda mahu rumah lebih kemas, segar, dan selesa. Selain itu, ia juga membantu selepas kerja ubah suai yang meninggalkan habuk halus.
Kami bersihkan ruang utama, lantai, kipas, tingkap, dapur, bilik air, dan permukaan yang mudah mengumpul habuk.

faqs.question: Berapa harga pakej cuci rumah di KL?
faqs.answer: Harga anggaran bermula sekitar RM250 untuk rumah kecil atau kondo. Namun, harga sebenar bergantung kepada saiz rumah, keadaan rumah, dan jenis cucian yang diperlukan.

faqs.question: Apa beza deep cleaning dan cucian biasa?
faqs.answer: Cucian biasa fokus pada sapu, mop, dan lap permukaan. Deep cleaning pula lebih terperinci. Ia termasuk bilik air, dapur, kipas, tingkap, celah jubin, dan kawasan yang susah dicapai.

faqs.question: Adakah pakej ini sesuai selepas renovasi?
faqs.answer: Ya, pakej ini sesuai selepas renovasi. Namun, post-renovation cleaning biasanya perlukan skop lebih khusus kerana ia melibatkan habuk simen, sisa cat, dan kotoran kerja ubah suai.

faqs.question: Berapa lama masa cuci rumah diambil?
faqs.answer: Untuk rumah bersaiz biasa, kerja boleh mengambil masa sekitar 4 hingga 6 jam. Masa sebenar bergantung kepada saiz rumah, tahap kekotoran, dan jumlah pekerja.

faqs.question: Bagaimana cara tempah pakej cuci rumah?
faqs.answer: Anda boleh WhatsApp RK Reno Solution. Kongsi jenis rumah, lokasi, saiz rumah, tarikh yang anda mahu, dan gambar keadaan rumah jika ada.
